name: Synology DSM
description: Imports a Synology NAS (hostname, model, DSM version, serial number, memory) into the knowledge graph as a server through the DSM Web API and gives AI clients its storage pools, volumes and drives with status and usage. Read-only: the plugin only signs in, reads and signs out. Settings: url (e.g. https://nas.example.org:5001, valid certificate), username and password (a dedicated DSM account in the administrators group, because DSM only shows system and storage information to administrators; the account must not use 2-step verification). If DSM blocks the Phoedox server after failed sign-ins, remove it from the block list under Control Panel > Security > Protection.

mcpTools.name: synology.sync
mcpTools.description: Import the Synology NAS into the knowledge graph now.

mcpTools.name: synology.storage
mcpTools.description: Storage of the Synology NAS: storage pools, volumes (status, file system, size, used and free space in GiB) and drives (model, size, status, SMART status, temperature).
